title: The Summit of the Upper Fly River
author: K. M. Villalobos
blurb: August Iversen, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
